payload.name: Affective Asymmetry in Irony Processing
payload.fact: Children show significantly lower comprehension accuracy for ironic praise compared to ironic criticism, which supports the affective asymmetry hypothesis in irony processing.
payload.boundary: Specific to children aged 7 to 11 years processing written ironic language.
